heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: Who shun thoughts alien to virtue
And hold your senses in servitude,
Whore to horrid desert tract used,
Holding umbrellas against the scorching sun,
Resting on the shoulders in order!
Did you not see my daughter and an aliens son
The ones in loving union covert on the way?
